_note: Who narrates and how. `names` are voices to look for in your ElevenLabs account, best first; the first one the account is allowed to use is taken (or pass --voice). `direction` is a delivery note the model follows without saying it aloud. `stability` 0.5 is the model's normal setting: lower is more varied, higher is flatter. `say` is the macOS voice used by --provider say, for timing tests only.
